title: data/workflows.json
description: Canonical n8n workflow state, keyed by workflow id. Machine-written by ingest/n8n-list.js.

active.description: Present in the full list but absent from the --active=true list means false.

server.description: Must be a key in data/servers.json

group.description: Assigned by the name-pattern rules in the brief, §8b

noise.description: Imported demo templates: names matching ^\d+- or empty\d|My workflow. Filterable out of the dashboard.

missingSince.description: Set when a previously seen id stops appearing in the list. Never deleted, so the dashboard can say "disappeared".

history.description: Append-only, one entry per observed state CHANGE (not per ingest). Powers "deactivated 3 days ago".
